examples: The report contains accurate information about last year's sales.
این گزارش اطلاعات دقیقی درباره فروش سال گذشته دارد.
We need accurate measurements before cutting the wood.
قبل از بریدن چوب، به اندازه‌گیری‌های دقیقی نیاز داریم.
Her description of the accident was accurate down to the smallest detail.
توضیح او از تصادف تا کوچک‌ترین جزئیات دقیق بود.
miniContext: Weather forecasters work hard to make their predictions as **accurate** as possible, even though nature is unpredictable. A truly accurate forecast can help farmers decide when to plant or harvest their crops. When a forecast turns out to be accurate several days in a row, people start to trust it more. Still, even the most accurate models can be wrong when conditions change suddenly.

examples: Children acquire language skills faster than adults do.
کودکان مهارت‌های زبانی را سریع‌تر از بزرگسالان کسب می‌کنند.
The company acquired a smaller startup last year.
شرکت سال گذشته یک استارتاپ کوچک‌تر را به دست آورد.
You can acquire new skills by taking online courses in your free time.
می‌توانی با گذراندن دوره‌های آنلاین در وقت آزادت مهارت‌های جدید کسب کنی.
miniContext: Over several years of travel, Noor managed to **acquire** a working knowledge of four different languages. She acquired most of her vocabulary simply by talking to people in markets and cafes. Grammar books helped too, but real conversations let her acquire a natural accent that books alone couldn't teach. Today, she jokes that the easiest way to acquire a language is to fall in love with the culture first.

examples: The old heater is no longer adequate for such a large house.
بخاری قدیمی دیگر برای چنین خانه بزرگی کافی نیست.
She felt the training she received was adequate for the job.
او احساس کرد آموزشی که دریافت کرده برای این شغل کافی بود.
Make sure there is adequate lighting before you start reading.
قبل از شروع به مطالعه، مطمئن شوید نور کافی وجود دارد.
miniContext: After the move, the family realized their new apartment barely had **adequate** storage space for all their belongings. The kitchen, in particular, lacked adequate counter space for cooking large meals. They solved the problem by adding shelves, which finally gave them adequate room for everything. It wasn't a perfect fix, but it was adequate until they could afford a bigger place.

examples: You may need to adjust the thermostat as the seasons change.
ممکن است لازم باشد با تغییر فصل‌ها، دمای ترموستات را تنظیم کنی.
She adjusted quickly to her new school after moving to a different city.
او پس از نقل‌مکان به شهری دیگر، به‌سرعت با مدرسه جدیدش تطبیق یافت.
Please adjust your seat before the plane takes off.
لطفاً قبل از برخاستن هواپیما، صندلی خود را تنظیم کنید.
miniContext: When Daniel started working night shifts, his body took weeks to **adjust** to the new sleep schedule. He adjusted his routine by blacking out his windows during the day and avoiding caffeine late at night. His diet also had to adjust, since his usual meal times no longer matched his new hours. Eventually, his body managed to adjust completely, and the night shifts felt almost normal.

examples: The dog became aggressive whenever strangers approached the gate.
سگ هر وقت غریبه‌ها به دروازه نزدیک می‌شدند، تهاجمی می‌شد.
The company launched an aggressive marketing campaign to boost sales.
شرکت یک کمپین بازاریابی شدید برای افزایش فروش راه‌اندازی کرد.
His aggressive driving style made his passengers nervous.
سبک رانندگی تهاجمی او باعث نگرانی مسافرانش می‌شد.
miniContext: During contract negotiations, the new manager took an unusually **aggressive** approach, pushing for terms the other side thought were unreasonable. His aggressive tactics worked at first, winning several quick concessions from the smaller supplier. Over time, though, the relationship suffered, and the supplier grew tired of such aggressive demands. Eventually, the company learned that a less aggressive strategy built partnerships that lasted much longer.

examples: The instructions were so ambiguous that nobody knew where to start.
دستورالعمل‌ها آن‌قدر مبهم بودند که هیچ‌کس نمی‌دانست از کجا شروع کند.
Her answer to the question was deliberately ambiguous.
پاسخ او به این سؤال عمداً مبهم بود.
The contract contains an ambiguous clause that both sides interpret differently.
قرارداد یک بند مبهم دارد که هر دو طرف آن را متفاوت تفسیر می‌کنند.
miniContext: The ending of the film was left intentionally **ambiguous**, so viewers could decide for themselves what really happened. Critics loved the ambiguous ending, saying it made the story more memorable than a clear resolution would have. Some fans, however, found the ambiguous plot frustrating and wanted a definite answer. Years later, people still argue online about what that ambiguous final scene actually meant.

examples: We anticipate heavy traffic on the highway this weekend.
ما پیش‌بینی می‌کنیم این آخر هفته ترافیک سنگینی در بزرگراه باشد.
The store anticipated high demand and ordered extra stock.
فروشگاه تقاضای بالا را پیش‌بینی کرد و موجودی اضافی سفارش داد.

باید سؤالات حضار را پیش‌بینی کنی و پاسخ‌هایت را آماده کنی.
miniContext: Good chess players learn to **anticipate** their opponent's next several moves, not just react to the current one. A skilled player can anticipate a trap two or three moves before it happens. Beginners often fail to anticipate anything beyond their very next turn. With practice, though, anyone can train themselves to anticipate more of the game ahead.

examples: This charger is compatible with most phone brands.
این شارژر با اکثر برندهای گوشی سازگار است.
The couple realized early on that they were compatible in most important ways.
این زوج از همان ابتدا فهمیدند که از جهات مهم با هم سازگار هستند.
Make sure the new software is compatible with your operating system.
مطمئن شوید که نرم‌افزار جدید با سیستم عامل شما سازگار است.
miniContext: Before buying new speakers, it's worth checking whether they are **compatible** with your existing sound system. Some older amplifiers are only compatible with a limited range of modern devices. Shops that sell audio equipment can usually tell you if two products are compatible before you buy. Choosing compatible gear from the start saves a lot of frustration later.

examples: The doctor recommended a comprehensive health checkup for her age.
پزشک برای سن او یک معاینه جامع سلامتی را توصیه کرد.
This textbook gives a comprehensive overview of world history.
این کتاب درسی یک نگاه جامع به تاریخ جهان ارائه می‌دهد.
They conducted a comprehensive review of the company's spending.
آنها یک بررسی جامع از هزینه‌های شرکت انجام دادند.
miniContext: Before launching the new product, the team put together a **comprehensive** plan covering marketing, pricing, and distribution. The comprehensive research included surveys with hundreds of potential customers across different cities. Nothing was left out of the comprehensive report, right down to packaging design. Thanks to that level of detail, the launch went far more smoothly than earlier, less comprehensive attempts had.

examples: The university offers two concurrent degree programs for ambitious students.
دانشگاه دو برنامه مدرک همزمان برای دانشجویان مشتاق ارائه می‌دهد.
He served two concurrent prison sentences for the related crimes.
او دو محکومیت زندان همزمان برای جرایم مرتبط گذراند.
The software can handle several concurrent users without slowing down.
این نرم‌افزار می‌تواند چندین کاربر همزمان را بدون کندی مدیریت کند.
miniContext: During the festival, three concurrent events took place on different stages, so visitors had to choose where to go. Running concurrent shows meant the organizers needed separate sound systems to avoid interference between them. Fans debated for weeks about which of the concurrent performances had been the best. Next year, organizers are considering fewer concurrent events so that everyone can see every act.

examples: Limited funding will constrain what the team can build this year.
بودجه محدود، آنچه تیم می‌تواند امسال بسازد را محدود خواهد کرد.
The old factory layout constrained how much the company could expand.
چیدمان قدیمی کارخانه میزان گسترش شرکت را محدود کرد.
Strict regulations constrain how doctors can prescribe certain medications.
مقررات سخت‌گیرانه، نحوه تجویز برخی داروها توسط پزشکان را محدود می‌کند.
miniContext: A tight deadline can **constrain** even the most talented designer's creativity. On this project, the budget also constrained which materials the architects could choose. Local building codes constrained the height of the tower even further. Despite everything that seemed to constrain the design, the final building still won an award for originality.

examples: The mayor's new tax plan proved highly controversial.
برنامه مالیاتی جدید شهردار بسیار بحث‌برانگیز از آب درآمد.
She wrote a controversial essay questioning the school's grading system.
او مقاله‌ای بحث‌برانگیز نوشت که سیستم نمره‌دهی مدرسه را زیر سؤال می‌برد.
The referee's controversial decision changed the outcome of the match.
تصمیم بحث‌برانگیز داور نتیجه بازی را تغییر داد.
miniContext: The artist's newest painting turned out to be the most **controversial** piece of the entire exhibition. Critics called the controversial image disrespectful, while others praised it as brave and necessary. The gallery almost removed the controversial painting after complaints, but decided to keep it on display. Months later, people were still debating whether the controversial work deserved all the attention it received.

examples: He prefers conventional methods of farming over newer technology.
او روش‌های مرسوم کشاورزی را به فناوری جدیدتر ترجیح می‌دهد.
Their wedding broke from conventional traditions in several ways.
عروسی آنها از چند جهت با سنت‌های مرسوم فاصله گرفت.
Conventional wisdom says you should save before you spend.
خرد مرسوم می‌گوید که باید قبل از خرج کردن، پس‌انداز کنید.
miniContext: Rather than following a **conventional** career path, Amir decided to start his own business straight out of school. His parents, who had always valued conventional jobs with steady paychecks, worried about the risk. Over time, though, his unconventional choice paid off better than any conventional job could have. Now he jokes that ignoring conventional advice was the best decision he ever made.

examples: The numbers on the map correspond to locations on this list.
اعداد روی نقشه با مکان‌های این فهرست مطابقت دارند.
Her salary didn't correspond to the amount of work she was doing.
حقوق او با میزان کاری که انجام می‌داد مطابقت نداشت.
The two witnesses' stories correspond closely with each other.
داستان‌های دو شاهد با یکدیگر مطابقت نزدیکی دارند.
miniContext: Each color on the chart is meant to **correspond** to a specific temperature range. Blue areas correspond to the coldest regions, while red areas correspond to the hottest. If the colors don't correspond correctly, the whole map becomes misleading. Scientists double-check that every shade continues to correspond to the right data before publishing the results.

examples: Many English words derive from Latin roots.
بسیاری از واژه‌های انگلیسی از ریشه‌های لاتین مشتق می‌شوند.
She derives great satisfaction from helping new employees settle in.
او رضایت زیادی از کمک به کارمندان جدید برای جا افتادن به دست می‌آورد.
Scientists derived the formula after years of careful observation.
دانشمندان این فرمول را پس از سال‌ها مشاهده دقیق به دست آوردند.
miniContext: The word "biology" is thought to **derive** from two Greek words meaning "life" and "study." Many scientific terms derive from Greek or Latin in a similar way. Linguists enjoy tracing how a single root can derive dozens of related words across different languages. Understanding where a word derives from often makes it much easier to remember its meaning.

examples: The two paintings have a distinct style, even though they're by the same artist.
این دو نقاشی سبک متمایزی دارند، حتی با اینکه کار یک هنرمند هستند.
There was a distinct smell of smoke coming from the kitchen.
بویی متمایز از دود از آشپزخانه به مشام می‌رسید.
Each region of the country has its own distinct dialect.
هر منطقه کشور گویش متمایز خاص خود را دارد.
miniContext: Twins are often thought to be identical, but Lily and Rosa have always had **distinct** personalities. Lily's distinct love of music shaped her whole childhood, while Rosa preferred sports. Even their handwriting is distinct enough that teachers never confused their homework. Friends say it's the little distinct habits, more than looks, that truly tell the sisters apart.

examples: One team has managed to dominate the league for the past three seasons.
یک تیم توانسته است طی سه فصل گذشته بر این لیگ مسلط باشد.
Tall buildings dominate the skyline of the downtown area.
ساختمان‌های بلند بر خط افق منطقه مرکز شهر مسلط هستند.
She tends to dominate conversations without meaning to.
او بدون اینکه قصدش را داشته باشد، تمایل دارد بر مکالمات مسلط شود.
miniContext: For nearly a decade, a single company managed to **dominate** the smartphone market almost completely. Its devices dominated sales charts year after year, leaving rivals struggling to catch up. Eventually, a smaller competitor found a way to dominate a specific niche the larger company had ignored. Markets rarely stay dominated by one player forever, no matter how strong they once seemed.

examples: Good lighting can enhance the mood of any room.
نور خوب می‌تواند حال‌وهوای هر اتاقی را بهبود بخشد.
The new update enhanced the app's speed significantly.
به‌روزرسانی جدید سرعت اپلیکیشن را به‌طور قابل توجهی بهبود بخشید.
A short walk before studying can enhance your focus.
یک پیاده‌روی کوتاه قبل از مطالعه می‌تواند تمرکز شما را بهبود بخشد.
miniContext: Chefs often add a pinch of salt to desserts, since it can **enhance** sweetness in surprising ways. A touch of lemon juice can also enhance the flavor of a rich, creamy sauce. Good lighting and plating enhance how appetizing a dish looks before anyone even tastes it. Small details like these enhance an ordinary meal far more than most home cooks realize.

examples: She gave explicit instructions not to disturb her during the meeting.
او دستورالعمل صریحی داد که در طول جلسه مزاحمش نشوند.
The contract contains an explicit clause about late payments.
قرارداد یک بند صریح درباره پرداخت‌های تأخیری دارد.
He was explicit about his expectations from the very first day.
او از همان روز اول درباره انتظاراتش صریح بود.
miniContext: Before the surgery, the doctor gave **explicit** instructions about what the patient could and could not eat beforehand. Nurses repeated the explicit list of medications to avoid, just to be safe. Because the instructions were so explicit, there was no confusion on the day of the operation. Clear, explicit communication like this is one reason the hospital has such a strong safety record.

examples: A good mediator can facilitate agreement between two angry neighbors.
یک میانجی خوب می‌تواند توافق بین دو همسایه عصبانی را تسهیل کند.
The new software facilitated communication between remote teams.
نرم‌افزار جدید ارتباط بین تیم‌های دوردست را تسهیل کرد.
Clear road signs facilitate traffic flow during rush hour.
تابلوهای واضح جاده‌ای جریان ترافیک را در ساعات شلوغی تسهیل می‌کنند.
miniContext: A skilled teacher doesn't just lecture; she tries to **facilitate** real discussion among students. Small group activities facilitate this kind of exchange far better than a quiet, silent classroom would. Open-ended questions also facilitate deeper thinking, since there's no single right answer to repeat. By learning to facilitate rather than simply instruct, she helped her students become more confident speakers.

examples: Gas prices tend to fluctuate throughout the year.
قیمت بنزین معمولاً در طول سال نوسان دارد.
Her mood fluctuated between excitement and nervousness before the show.
حال او قبل از نمایش بین هیجان و نگرانی نوسان داشت.
The company's stock price has fluctuated wildly this month.
قیمت سهام شرکت این ماه به‌شدت نوسان داشته است.
miniContext: Body temperature can naturally **fluctuate** by about a degree throughout the day. It tends to fluctuate lower in the early morning and rise slightly by evening. During illness, temperature can fluctuate much more dramatically, sometimes within just a few hours. Doctors pay close attention when a patient's temperature continues to fluctuate outside the normal range.

examples: The new law provides a legal framework for online privacy.
قانون جدید یک چارچوب قانونی برای حریم خصوصی آنلاین فراهم می‌کند.
This book offers a useful framework for understanding economics.
این کتاب چارچوب مفیدی برای درک اقتصاد ارائه می‌دهد.
The company built its training program around a simple framework.
شرکت برنامه آموزشی خود را حول یک چارچوب ساده طراحی کرد.
miniContext: Before writing a single line of code, the developers agreed on a shared **framework** for the project. This framework defined how different parts of the app would communicate with each other. Having a clear framework from the start saved the team from major conflicts later on. Newer developers joining the project found the existing framework easy to follow once they studied it.

examples: There was an implicit agreement that no one would mention the argument again.
یک توافق ضمنی وجود داشت که هیچ‌کس دوباره آن دعوا را مطرح نکند.
Her tone carried an implicit warning that he ignored.
لحن او یک هشدار ضمنی داشت که او آن را نادیده گرفت.
The contract has an implicit understanding about overtime pay.
قرارداد یک تفاهم ضمنی درباره دستمزد اضافه‌کاری دارد.
miniContext: In many families, there is an **implicit** rule about who sits where at dinner, even if no one ever says it out loud. This implicit tradition can feel strange to a new partner joining the table for the first time. Over time, outsiders usually learn these implicit rules just by watching closely. Unlike written laws, implicit customs are rarely explained, only absorbed.

examples: Fear of failure can inhibit creativity in the classroom.
ترس از شکست می‌تواند خلاقیت در کلاس درس را مانع شود.
The medication inhibits the growth of certain bacteria.
این دارو مانع رشد برخی باکتری‌ها می‌شود.
Strict rules at work can inhibit employees from sharing new ideas.
قوانین سخت‌گیرانه در محل کار می‌تواند مانع از به اشتراک گذاشتن ایده‌های جدید توسط کارمندان شود.
miniContext: Too much criticism early on can **inhibit** a child's willingness to try new things. A harsh comment from a coach can inhibit confidence for years afterward, even once the skill is mastered. Supportive environments, by contrast, rarely inhibit curiosity the way harsh ones do. Parents who want their kids to take risks should watch for habits that quietly inhibit that courage.

examples: Trust is an integral part of any strong friendship.
اعتماد بخشی ضروری و جدایی‌ناپذیر از هر دوستی قوی است.
The drummer is an integral member of the band, not just background support.
درامر عضوی ضروری و جدایی‌ناپذیر از گروه است، نه فقط پشتیبانی پس‌زمینه.
Regular testing is integral to producing reliable software.
تست منظم بخشی ضروری و جدایی‌ناپذیر از تولید نرم‌افزار قابل اعتماد است.
miniContext: Good lighting is **integral** to how a photograph turns out, often more than the camera itself. Early in her career, the photographer treated lighting as integral enough to spend hours setting it up before every shoot. Over time, that integral habit became second nature, almost automatic. Students who skip this step rarely understand why lighting is so integral until they see their own disappointing photos.

examples: She has a legitimate reason for missing the meeting.
او یک دلیل معتبر برای غایب بودن از جلسه دارد.
The company operates as a legitimate business with proper licenses.
شرکت به‌عنوان یک کسب‌وکار قانونی و با مجوزهای مناسب فعالیت می‌کند.
His concerns about safety were entirely legitimate.
نگرانی‌های او درباره ایمنی کاملاً معتبر بودند.
miniContext: When customers complained about the delayed shipment, the company first assumed the complaints weren't **legitimate**. After checking the records, managers realized the concerns were completely legitimate; a warehouse error had delayed dozens of orders. Treating the complaints as legitimate from the start would have avoided a lot of frustration. The company now trains staff to assume a complaint is legitimate until proven otherwise.

examples: The weather was cold; nevertheless, they went for a walk.
هوا سرد بود؛ با این حال، آنها به پیاده‌روی رفتند.
The plan had flaws, but the team decided to proceed nevertheless.
این برنامه ایراداتی داشت، اما تیم با این حال تصمیم گرفت ادامه دهد.
She was exhausted; nevertheless, she finished the marathon.
او بسیار خسته بود؛ با این حال، ماراتن را به پایان رساند.
miniContext: The hike was longer and steeper than anyone had expected. **Nevertheless**, the group pushed on, determined to reach the summit before sunset. Rain began to fall halfway up; nevertheless, no one suggested turning back. By the time they reached the top, exhausted but proud, the view made clear why they had kept going nevertheless.

examples: Notwithstanding the heavy rain, the farmers finished the harvest on time.
با وجود باران شدید، کشاورزان برداشت را به‌موقع تمام کردند.
The deal went ahead notwithstanding several last-minute objections.
این توافق با وجود چند مخالفت لحظه آخری پیش رفت.
Notwithstanding his young age, he led the project successfully.
با وجود سن کم او، پروژه را با موفقیت هدایت کرد.
miniContext: Notwithstanding the committee's early doubts, the small library managed to raise enough money to stay open. Notwithstanding a shrinking budget, the staff still organized free reading programs for local children every summer. Donors kept giving, notwithstanding the tough economic year the whole town was facing. The library's survival, notwithstanding every obstacle, became a point of quiet pride for the community.

examples: A persistent cough sent her to the doctor after two weeks.
یک سرفه مداوم او را پس از دو هفته به پزشک فرستاد.
His persistent effort finally earned him the promotion.
تلاش مداوم او بالاخره ارتقای شغلی را برایش به ارمغان آورد.
The company faced persistent complaints about late deliveries.
شرکت با شکایات مداوم درباره تأخیر در تحویل مواجه بود.
miniContext: Despite years of advertising campaigns, one myth about the product proved remarkably **persistent** among customers. The persistent belief that the device was fragile kept many shoppers away, even after design improvements fixed the issue. Reviewers tried to correct the record, but the rumor remained persistent online. Only after a flood of positive, persistent testimonials did public opinion finally start to shift.

examples: We need precise measurements for the bridge to be safe.
برای ایمن بودن پل، به اندازه‌گیری‌های دقیق نیاز داریم.
Her precise instructions made the recipe easy to follow.
دستورالعمل‌های دقیق او باعث شد دنبال کردن دستور پخت آسان باشد.
The surgeon's precise hands made the operation look effortless.
دست‌های دقیق جراح، عمل را بی‌دردسر به نظر رساند.
miniContext: Clock makers used to compete over who could build the most **precise** timepiece in the world. A precise clock was essential for ships navigating the ocean, since even small errors could mean disaster. Modern GPS systems now rely on atomic clocks that are far more precise than anything from that era. Still, the obsession with being precise hasn't changed; only the tools have.

examples: The preliminary results look promising, though more testing is needed.
نتایج مقدماتی امیدوارکننده به نظر می‌رسند، اگرچه آزمایش بیشتری لازم است.
They held a preliminary meeting before the official negotiations began.
آنها قبل از شروع مذاکرات رسمی، یک جلسه مقدماتی برگزار کردند.
A preliminary investigation found no evidence of wrongdoing.
بررسی مقدماتی هیچ شواهدی از تخلف پیدا نکرد.
miniContext: Before the full study began, researchers ran a small **preliminary** test to check their methods. The preliminary data suggested the treatment might work, though the sample size was far too small to be certain. Encouraged by those preliminary numbers, the team secured funding for a much larger trial. Scientists always treat preliminary findings with caution until a bigger study can confirm them.

examples: Losing her mentor had a profound effect on her career choices.
از دست دادن مربی‌اش تأثیر عمیقی بر انتخاب‌های شغلی او گذاشت.
The book left a profound impression on young readers.
این کتاب تأثیر عمیقی بر خوانندگان جوان گذاشت.
There is a profound difference between hearing about poverty and experiencing it.

miniContext: Traveling alone for the first time had a surprisingly **profound** effect on how Mina saw the world. The profound sense of independence she felt changed how she approached decisions back home. Friends noticed a profound shift in her confidence within just a few months. Looking back, she says few experiences in her life have ever felt so profound.

examples: Companies struggle to retain good employees without offering fair pay.

miniContext: After the merger, the new management worked hard to **retain** the staff who had made the original company successful. Offering flexible hours helped retain several key engineers who had other job offers. Even so, the company couldn't retain everyone, and a few experienced managers left within the first year. Leadership later admitted that retaining talent during a merger is far harder than retaining customers.

examples: The bridge was built to be robust enough to survive strong earthquakes.

یک اقتصاد مقاوم و پایدار می‌تواند ضربه‌های کوچک را بدون سقوط به بحران تحمل کند.
miniContext: Engineers tested the new phone case by dropping it from increasing heights to see how **robust** it really was. The robust design absorbed most impacts without a single crack, even from two meters up. Customers trust a robust case far more than a flimsy one, especially for an expensive phone. After months of testing, the company finally felt confident calling their product truly robust.

examples: The first meeting went badly, but subsequent talks improved quickly.

کتاب‌های بعدی او هرگز به موفقیت رمان اولش نرسیدند.
miniContext: The company's first product launch was a disaster, but **subsequent** versions fixed almost every early complaint. Each subsequent update added features that customers had specifically requested. By the third subsequent release, reviewers were calling it one of the best apps in its category. The lesson the team learned was that a rocky start doesn't have to define every subsequent attempt.

examples: Never underestimate how much a small act of kindness can mean to someone.

سرمایه‌گذارانی که ریسک‌ها را دست‌کم می‌گیرند، معمولاً سریع پول خود را از دست می‌دهند.
miniContext: Critics tend to **underestimate** how much work goes into a seemingly simple piece of writing. Reviewers underestimated the research behind the book, assuming the author had simply written from memory. The publisher's marketing team also underestimated how popular the topic would become once it reached readers. By the time it topped the bestseller list, nobody dared to underestimate the author again.

examples: This small kitchen tool is surprisingly versatile for its size.

miniContext: Olive oil is one of the most **versatile** ingredients in any kitchen, used for frying, baking, and even dressing salads. Its versatile nature makes it a staple in cuisines around the world, from the Mediterranean to the Middle East. Chefs appreciate how a single versatile bottle can replace half a dozen specialty oils. Few ingredients earn the word versatile as honestly as this one does.

miniContext: What started as a **temporary** arrangement to cover for a sick colleague turned into a permanent job for Hana. Her temporary role gave her just enough time to prove she could handle the responsibilities. Managers often notice when a temporary worker goes above and beyond, just as they did with her. Two years later, nobody at the office remembers her position was ever meant to be temporary.

miniContext: Quitting sugar for a month led to a **significant** change in how Daniela felt every morning. The significant improvement in her energy surprised even her doctor, who hadn't expected such quick results. Her sleep also improved significantly, though that took a few more weeks to notice. For Daniela, the significant difference was enough proof that the hard month had been worth it.
